## v1.14.0

### Changes

2026-09-29 · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/releases/tag/v1.14.0)

#### Features 🎉
* feat(web-integration): add BrowserAgent page selection actions by @quanru in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/2774
* feat(test): add setAIContext node for midscene/test by @yuyutaotao in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3188
* feat(ios): support gateway WDA base URLs by @quanru in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3187
* feat(core): support Responses API with configuration and documentation by @EAGzzyCSL in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3161

#### Fixes 🐞
* fix(core): record HTTP responses on model parsing failures by @EAGzzyCSL in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3185
* fix(site): restore legacy URLs and refresh favicon cache by @yuyutaotao in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3198
* fix(site): redirect retired documentation URLs by @yuyutaotao in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3202
* fix(cli): upgrade yargs for Node.js 26 compatibility by @EAGzzyCSL in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3203

#### Refactors ♻️
* refactor(core): configure locate result keys and aliases by @EAGzzyCSL in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3189

#### Documentation 📖
* docs(site): consolidate images under a dedicated directory by @yuyutaotao in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3186
